rows.en: －　Outside the Comm Center　－
－　Narusawa's voice comes from￥　　inside the Comm Center　－
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１３Really? You passed!＝＠１４５＿０１４That job's pretty tough, but￥give it your all!＝＠１４５＿０１５Take care!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１６I see...￥So he's all grown up now...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１７Oh! You... How long have you￥been standing there...＝＠１４５＿０１８Don't tell me you heard that?
Sorry, just a little...
Not a thing! Not a word!
Sorry, just a little...
Not a thing! Not a word!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１９I-I see... This is awkward...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２０You didn't?!￥...Well, good, then.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２１You're done with today's￥training, aren't you?
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２２Then quit wandering around and￥get back to your room.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２３I hardly ever get calls out￥here, but...＝＠１４５＿０２４Seems my kid brother passed the￥space traffic controller exam.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２５For once, he was the one who￥called me.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２６Lucky I finished work early￥today. Normally I'd still be on￥the job at this hour.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２７He ought to know there's a time￥and place for calls like that...
He shouldn't call, huh?
You look happy, though.
He shouldn't call, huh?
You seem happy, though.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０２８Right. I'll have to talk to him.＝＠１４５＿０２９Now, you should head back to￥your room and get some rest.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０３０Huh! Ah...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０３１Can you tell?＝＠１４５＿０３２Well... I'd been worried about￥him for a long time...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００１My brother wanted the same job￥I used to do.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００２I talked about my work so often,￥I guess he got interested.
You two must be close.
What kind of job is it?
You must be very close.
What kind of job is it?

＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００３I suppose we are.＝＠１４６＿００４He's the youngest. We're about￥seven years apart, so I was the￥one who looked after him.＝＠１４６＿００５He was never very dependable, so￥I was always fussing over him￥one way or another.
What a good big brother.
Got a bro complex?
What a good big brother.
Got a bro complex?
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００６You think? To me it was just￥normal, so I never really￥thought about it.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００７Still, he's really grown up.＝＠１４６＿００８To think he'll be doing the same￥work I used to do...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿００９A what...?￥Don't go abbreviating things!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１０Anyway, I ended up talking way￥too long today.＝＠１４６＿０１１I need to get back to work. You￥should head back too, and rest￥up for tomorrow.

＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１２It's at Sophia's Space Traffic￥Control Center. They manage the￥Gates around Sophia.＝＠１４６＿０１３They also track space debris,￥meteorite movements and so on...＝＠１４６＿０１４It's important work. It keeps￥the shuttles' Gate transits￥safe, and Sophia too.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１５It's pretty demanding, but he's￥a hard worker. He'll manage.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１６It's my middle brother who's the￥problem... Not that worrying￥about it does me any good...＝＠１４６＿０１７Wonder who he takes after...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１８He's irresponsible, he gets￥carried away, and he's always￥reckless...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０１９He just drifts around from one￥odd job to another.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２０Honestly, what a headache...
You sound like a dad.
Lots of brothers, then?
You sound like a dad.
Lots of brothers, then?
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２１We're far apart in age, and I'm￥the eldest.＝＠１４６＿０２２I suppose from the outside it￥might look that way.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２３Yeah, there are three of us.￥Pretty rare, huh?!＝＠１４６＿０２４These days there are even fewer￥kids than in my generation.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２５With lots of siblings, it's￥noisy every single day!
Sounds fun.
Sounds noisy.
Sounds fun.
Sounds noisy.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２６Well, having lots of siblings￥has its ups and downs.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２７That's true. Still, that can be￥kind of fun too...
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２８You probably wouldn't get that.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４６＿０２９Now then, off to your room.＝＠１４６＿０３０Don't go hanging around the￥facility too late.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿００１Ah, look at that. I got to￥talking too long again.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿００２Somehow, whenever I talk with￥you, I end up saying too much.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４７＿００３Get some rest for tomorrow.
